content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied because required prior authorization was absent, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. Medical-necessity appeals on similar claims paid 0/8, while resubmission would not cure the authorization defect; the patient should not be billed for the provider’s authorization failure. With no secondary payer or viable payer remedy, the balance is uncollectible.","action":"write_off"}
